{{Top}}
{{Citation}}
[[File:TIE_Squadron_RS10BT2.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A squadron of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]] over [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]]]
A '''squadron''' was any group of coordinated aerial or space [[Warship/Legends|warships]]. They could be made up of [[Starfighter/Legends|Starfighters]], [[Bomber/Legends|Bombers]], [[Gunship/Legends|Gunships]], and [[Capital ship/Legends|Capital ships]]. Squadrons could be permanent or temporary and were used for a variety of missions. The most common make up for starfighter squadrons was 12 ships.

==Missions==
[[Starfighter/Legends|Starfighters]] were used in a huge variety of missions. The most common were attack missions, seek and destroy, escorts and reconnaissance.

[[Bomber/Legends|Bombers]] were used to assault ground targets or larger warships.

[[Gunship/Legends|Gunships]] were used to seek and destroy starfighters and bombers and/or to protect capital ships.

[[Capital ship/Legends|Capital ships]] were sometimes called groups instead of squadrons; however, they were essentially used in the same way as their smaller counterparts, only on a larger scale.

==Organization==
Typically Squadrons operated under a squadron commander, with an Executive Officer, and Second in command. Their personal ranks varied depending on the type of squadron. For Example; a starfighter squadron may have a [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] or [[Captain/Legends|Captain]], while a squadron of Capital Ships would be under a full [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]], [[Commodore/Legends|Commodore]], or [[General/Legends|General]].

A squadron consists of three [[flight group/Legends|flights]] of four starfighters. Three squadrons consist a [[fighter wing/Legends|wing]].<ref name="The Farlander Papers">{{StoryCite|story=The Farlander Papers|book=Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)}}</ref>
